title: Collisions & Linear Momentum
description: Investigate 1D elastic and inelastic collisions on an air track, coefficient of restitution (e), linear momentum conservation, and kinetic energy loss

variables.m1Desc: Mass of the first glider cart on the air track
variables.m2Desc: Mass of the second glider cart on the air track
variables.v1Desc: Initial velocity of cart 1 (+ right, - left)
variables.v2Desc: Initial velocity of cart 2 (+ right, - left)
variables.restitutionDesc: Ratio of relative separation velocity to approach velocity (1 = elastic, 0 = completely inelastic)
variables.frictionDesc: Dissipation losses due to track air cushion drag in real mode

presets.elasticEqualDesc: Full velocity transfer between equal mass gliders in ideal elastic collision (e = 1)
presets.inelasticStickingDesc: Carts stick together after collision with maximum kinetic energy dissipation (e = 0)
presets.headOnDesc: Gliders moving toward each other with opposing velocities (e = 0.9)
presets.heavyLightDesc: Massive cart catapults light stationary cart with high velocity

formulas.momentum: Total linear momentum conservation in the absence of external net forces
formulas.restitution: Coefficient of restitution definition based on relative velocities
formulas.v1Prime: Analytical post-collision velocity formula for cart 1
formulas.kineticEnergy: Total mechanical kinetic energy of both glider carts

realMode.inertiaEffect: Effect of glider mass distribution and slight air cushion imperfections
realMode.restitutionLoss: Dissipation of mechanical energy into heat, acoustic vibrations, and bumper deformation
realMode.airFriction: Aerodynamic drag slowing down moving gliders over distance

charts.momentum: Momentum p₁, p₂ and Total P (kg·m/s)

guided.step1Title: Step 1: Verify Momentum Conservation in Elastic Collision
guided.step1Desc: Run with default values (e = 1) and note how total linear momentum remains perfectly conserved before and after impact.
guided.step2Title: Step 2: Measure Kinetic Energy Loss in Inelastic Collision
guided.step2Desc: Select 'Completely Inelastic' (e = 0). Notice that while momentum is conserved, mechanical kinetic energy drops significantly.
guided.step3Desc: Make m₁ substantially larger than m₂ and verify the resulting velocity amplification on the lighter target cart.
